column1: # config-manifest.tsv — CONFIG SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (SSOT) for the Charon fleet.
# MECHANISM: every fleet-managed provider is declared EXACTLY ONCE here (in git, in the PRIVATE
# rig). The SYNC tool propagates this manifest to every config source (local ~/.charon + the 4-LOM
# gateway /data volume), and the GATE REDs whenever any source's providers.json diverges from this
# manifest. Editing a provider on disk is no longer a thing — the workflow is: edit the manifest,
# then `fleet/config-sync.sh`.
# FORMAT — TSV, one row per provider, columns:
#   1. provider    provider id (lowercase; matches `name` in providers.json; the `add-provider.sh`
#                  1st positional)
#   2. key_env     env var carrying the API key (NAME only — never a value; the manifest is
#                  committed to a PRIVATE rig because the operator's active-provider set is
#                  sensitive, but key names are public-safe and not secret)
#   3. base_url    OpenAI-compatible endpoint (http(s)://.../v1); may be empty for providers
#                  whose preset owns the URL (rare; manifest authors prefer explicit)
#   4. tiers       space-separated tiers the provider is eligible for (free|paid|probe) — a
#                  hint for the manager (free = usable on free-tier models, paid = metered,
#                  probe = one-shot capability test); the routing engine still picks per-pool
#   5. note        human-readable note (1 line; tab-free)
# IDEMPOTENT: re-running `fleet/config-sync.sh` from this manifest is a no-op when already in sync.
# EDIT POLICY: this is the only place to add/remove/update a fleet-managed provider. NEVER hand-
# edit providers.json on a target — `config-sync.sh` will overwrite your edit on the next run.
# SOURCE (the 11 providers keyed on the 4-LOM gateway, per `fleet/state/CG-PROVIDERS.md` 2026-07-14
# + 1 active-pending-key provider the operator has marked ACTIVE). The locally-mirrored subset is
# the intersection of (manifest) and (whatever is currently on disk at a target); the gate names
# any delta so the operator can re-sync.
# IMPORTANT: this manifest is committed to the PRIVATE rig (charon-private). Do NOT mirror it to a
# public repo — the operator's active-provider set is sensitive (a public view leaks which providers
# the operator is keyed into, an attack-surface enumeration).
# Row grammar check: every row MUST have exactly 5 tab-separated fields. `awk -F'\t' 'NF!=5' this`
# on a clean manifest yields nothing.
